2006-06-08.priorPricingDate: 5 May 2006 · EONIA swap curve, weeks before the June decision
2006-06-08.priorPricingNote: The ECB reconstructed the main refinancing minimum bid rate from EONIA swaps. It reported market consensus on a rise to 2.75% in June from the known 2.50% May rate. See chart 3 on page 76.
2006-06-08.priorInstrument: Minimum bid rate implied by the EONIA swap curve

2006-07-06.priorPricingDate: 5 May 2006 · EONIA swap curve, before the intervening June decision
2006-07-06.priorPricingNote: The ECB reported that the May curve implied a June increase to 2.75% and an unchanged July minimum bid rate. The zero is the July increment conditional on that projected June step. See chart 3 on page 76.
2006-07-06.priorInstrument: Minimum bid rate implied by the EONIA swap curve

2006-08-03.priorPricingDate: Reuters report before the 3 August 2006 decision; exchange quote time unavailable
2006-08-03.priorPricingNote: Reuters reported that EONIA prices fully incorporated a 25 bp rise in the ECB refinancing rate. The policy target in this period was the main refinancing rate.

2006-12-07.priorPricingDate: 10 November 2006, weeks before the December decision
2006-12-07.priorPricingNote: Reuters reported a fully priced rise in the December refinancing rate to 3.50% from 3.25% in the Friday EONIA market. The original report was published on 12 November.

2015-12-03.priorPricingDate: 2–3 December 2015 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2015-12-03.priorPricingNote: The EONIA curve incorporated a 10 bp cut to the deposit facility rate at this meeting. The further 10 bp of easing related to September 2016.

2016-03-10.priorPricingDate: 9–10 March 2016 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2016-03-10.priorPricingNote: The EONIA curve incorporated at least 10 bp of easing at this meeting. This floor does not identify the exact expected cut.

2019-09-12.priorPricingDate: 24–25 July 2019 ECB briefing, weeks before the September decision
2019-09-12.priorPricingNote: At the July meeting the EONIA curve showed a 10 bp September cut in the deposit facility rate. The ECB published the account on 22 August. A September-eve observation is unavailable here.

2022-07-21.priorPricingDate: 2022-06-08 · end of ECB bulletin market review
2022-07-21.priorPricingNote: The ECB attributed a first 25 bp increase to the July meeting in the June curve. This observation predates the July decision by 43 days and does not measure the immediate surprise.

2022-12-15.priorPricingDate: 14–15 December 2022 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2022-12-15.priorPricingNote: The ECB described the short end of its overnight index swap curve and reported market pricing for a 50 bp rise at the December meeting. It separately described another 50 bp step expected in February.
2022-12-15.priorInstrument: Euro-area overnight index swap forward curve

2023-02-02.priorPricingDate: 2023-02-01 · end of ECB bulletin market review
2023-02-02.priorPricingNote: The €STR OIS curve came close to pricing a 50 bp February increase. The bulletin supplied no exact number for the expected move.

2023-05-04.priorPricingDate: 2023-05-03 · end of ECB bulletin market review
2023-05-04.priorPricingNote: The €STR OIS forward curve priced a 34 bp increment specifically for May, and separately a 16 bp June increment. The change for May can be compared with the 25 bp deposit-rate increase.

2023-06-15.priorPricingDate: 14–15 June 2023 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2023-06-15.priorPricingNote: The €STR forwards incorporated a 25 bp rise at the June meeting and separately another 25 bp in July. The ECB published the account on 13 July.
2023-06-15.earlierPriorPricingNote: The ECB reported a separate 16 bp June increment before the May meeting. The May decision intervened before the June briefing.

2023-07-27.priorPricingDate: 2023-07-26 · end of ECB bulletin market review
2023-07-27.priorPricingNote: The ECB used the €STR OIS curve at the end of its review to identify a 25 bp increment for the July meeting.

2023-09-14.priorPricingDate: 26–27 July 2023 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2023-09-14.priorPricingNote: In July the ECB reported a 56% market-implied chance of an additional 25 bp rise in September. It did not specify all remaining outcomes or an exact expected September move. September pricing could differ.

2024-06-06.priorPricingDate: 5–6 June 2024 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2024-06-06.priorPricingNote: The meeting account described a 25 bp June cut as fully incorporated. Its opening market review described investors as almost certain of that cut. These are rounded characterisations, without a tick-level price.
2024-06-06.priorInstrument: Euro-area overnight index swap market pricing
2024-06-06.earlierPriorPricingNote: The April bulletin reported 20 bp of easing for the June meeting. The April decision intervened before the June briefing.

2024-09-12.priorPricingDate: 2024-09-11 · end of ECB bulletin market review
2024-09-12.priorPricingNote: The €STR forward curve incorporated a 25 bp cut at the September meeting. The ECB account also explicitly identifies the deposit facility rate.

2024-10-17.priorPricingDate: 16–17 October 2024 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2024-10-17.priorPricingNote: The account reported a 25 bp cut priced for the October meeting. The October bulletin characterised 16 October pricing as almost fully incorporating that cut. The account gives a rounded step without an exact quote time.
2024-10-17.priorInstrument: Euro-area policy-rate market pricing in the ECB Governing Council account

2024-12-12.priorPricingDate: 2024-12-11 · end of ECB bulletin market review
2024-12-12.priorPricingNote: The €STR forward curve incorporated a 25 bp December cut as of 11 December.
2024-12-12.earlierPriorPricingNote: The ECB described a further 25 bp reduction expected at the December meeting. The October decision intervened before the December observation.

2025-03-06.priorPricingDate: 2025-03-05 · end of ECB bulletin market review
2025-03-06.priorPricingNote: The ECB reported a 25 bp cut priced for its March meeting, distinct from the total cuts priced through year-end.

2025-04-17.priorPricingDate: 16–17 April 2025 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2025-04-17.priorPricingNote: The account reported financial-market pricing for a full 25 bp cut at the April meeting, during trading volatility following trade-policy announcements. It did not identify a particular quoted contract.
2025-04-17.priorInstrument: Euro-area policy-rate market pricing in the ECB Governing Council account

2025-06-05.priorPricingDate: 3–5 June 2025 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2025-06-05.priorPricingNote: The account reported that markets incorporated a 25 bp cut at the June meeting. It distinguished a later cut whose timing remained uncertain and did not specify the precise contract.
2025-06-05.priorInstrument: Euro-area policy-rate market pricing in the ECB Governing Council account

2026-06-11.priorPricingDate: 10–11 June 2026 ECB meeting briefing, before the decision; quote time unavailable
2026-06-11.priorPricingNote: The account describes a fully priced first 25 bp rise for June, with a separate 25 bp rise priced for September. The quoted extract distinguishes markets from the survey and gives no specific contract.
2026-06-11.priorInstrument: Euro-area policy-rate market pricing in the ECB Governing Council account
